pr_title: can_mcux_flexcan: update socket can instances initialization
pr_body:
The socket can driver is initialized with only one instance
by hard code, so couldn't use DT marco to iterate all can
device instances and initialize them together.

fix:  #31733 

Signed-off-by: peng1 chen <peng1.chen@intel.com>
pr_comments: We could use the zephyr,can-primary and zephyr,can-secondary labels.
This resolves the build error for me

> We could use the zephyr,can-primary and zephyr,can-secondary labels.

yes, have changed to use zephyr,can-primary label.
I've done an attempt at fixing the issues in a broader sense in this PR: #31885
Closing as this is fixed by #31885 that has been merged.

comments: the socket can driver in "socket_can_generic.h" is hard code, it only defined one name '#define SOCKET_CAN_NAME_1 "SOCKET_CAN_1"' and one socket context struct "static struct socket_can_context socket_can_context_1", when invoking "DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY" to initialize all can device instances, the instance number starts from 0, so it will report error like " 'SOCKET_CAN_NAME_0' undeclared here (not in a function); did you mean 'SOCKET_CAN_NAME_1", also if there are many can devices, it also will report same error.

review_comments: Please add a guard for `device_get_binding()` returning `NULL`. Otherwise looks good.
